blind.description: A stylized medieval kite/heater shield. It features a curved wooden body made of vertical planks, a dark reddish-brown reinforced border secured with metal rivets, and a round central metal boss (umbo). The reverse side shows smooth wooden construction with a small dark metal hand grip fixture at center. The geometry is solid, smooth, and fully enclosed.
blind.from_above: A thin curved horizontal strip or shallow arc with a central dome-shaped protrusion (the boss) and a pointed top edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40% as tall as the figure (approx. 2.2 to 2.5 feet tall) and roughly 1.5 feet wide.
